title: Implement and validate the first reversible local-storage port seam
purpose: Implement only the mechanical source-boundary extraction accepted by ARC-WP-010, prove behavioral and stored-data equivalence on the exact result commit, and preserve single-revert rollback before any controlled multi-AI pilot may begin.
invariants: The implementation is exactly the adapter extraction defined by ARC-WP-010 and no broader refactor.
The complete storage adapter body, lexical name, API, coercions, empty-string read fallback, write error propagation, telemetry and one-shot fault behavior remain semantically unchanged.
All storage keys, database names, store names, record ids, revisions, serialized payloads and identifiers remain unchanged.
Direct window.localStorage access is owned only by the new runtime part 04; direct IndexedDB ownership remains only in runtime part 05, which is not modified.
All existing ContentStore, AppState, performance and test-API callers remain unchanged.
No learner-facing UI, copy, navigation, activity, import, persistence behavior, progression, bilan or recommendation changes are introduced.
Developer and adversarial QA write scopes are disjoint.
QA may change the checks registry only by adding tests/contract_storage_boundary.py to the mandatory list; every existing registry entry and policy remains unchanged.
The implementation is prepared through the Remote Agent Worktree from the exact base commit and is not merged autonomously.
The exact result commit passes the Remote Agent tested-result status, permanent Player CI, PR scope and full player test profile including the focused contract.
Rollback is a single revert and requires no learner-data migration or remote compensation.
Stage D remains blocked until the implementation is merged and separately accepted by the governor.
requiredEvidence: exact Remote Agent base and result commit SHAs
focused storage-boundary contract test authored independently from implementation files
focused contract registered as one additional mandatory Player CI check
full player test result on the exact result commit
Remote agent worktree / tested result success on the exact result commit
Player CI / gate success on the exact result commit
static proof of sole localStorage and IndexedDB primitive owners
existing browser persistence and naming test pass
adversarial QA review distinguishing evidence, claim, assumption and absence of evidence
adversarialTests: fail if any implementation file outside the four developer paths changes
fail if QA modifies an implementation path or developer modifies either QA path
fail if the checks registry changes by anything other than adding tests/contract_storage_boundary.py to mandatory
fail if window.localStorage remains in runtime part 00 or appears in any runtime source other than part 04
fail if indexedDB ownership moves or part 05 changes
fail if any frozen key or storage payload marker changes
fail if source manifest order is not 00, 04, 05, 10
fail if the storage adapter operation set or fallback/error behavior changes
fail if release config, RC label, contract, UI or unrelated runtime source changes
fail if generated dist, reports or release files enter the pull request
fail if rollback requires a data migration
fail if a green test is used to claim behavior outside its exercised environment
nonGoals: merge synchronous and durable persistence ports
change a storage key, payload, schema version or identifier
introduce asynchronous storage semantics, dependency injection or a repository hierarchy
refactor ContentStore, AppState or any caller
change player features, UX, accessibility, pedagogy or RC719 reservations
change release identity or publish a new product release
change the test runner, registry schema, release policy or any existing check
add backend, accounts, synchronization, catalog, commerce, institutions or marketplace
independentReview: Developer through Remote Agent Worktree limited to the four implementation paths
Adversarial QA limited to apps/player/tests/contract_storage_boundary.py and the single mandatory registry addition, with read-only review elsewhere
Integrator limited to evidence/provenance records and read-only source/test inspection
Architecture and Repository Governor limited to work-package, state and review records
permanent GitHub Actions Player CI and PR scope checks
rollback: Revert the Stage C implementation pull request. The adapter returns to runtime part 00, runtime part 04 and the focused test are removed, the source manifest, owner map and mandatory test registry return to their prior state, and no learner-data or remote-system migration is required.
